name: Mei Lian Tan
bio:
Mei Lian Tan's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not with karting or a family legacy, but with a deep fascination for engineering principles. After graduating top of her class at the National University of Singapore with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, she secured a coveted position at a local automotive firm. However, the allure of the racetrack proved too strong, and she transitioned to a small Formula Ford team, quickly making a name for herself with her meticulous approach to data analysis and setup optimization.

Over the past two decades, Mei Lian has honed her skills in various racing series, from GT racing to open-wheel championships. Her strength lies in her ability to remain calm and collected under pressure, enabling her to make crucial decisions during races. She is known for her collaborative style, fostering strong relationships with drivers and mechanics alike, and she prides herself on her meticulous attention to detail, ensuring that every aspect of the car's performance is optimized to its fullest potential. Her loyalty to a team is unwavering, and she seeks to create a winning environment where everyone can thrive.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled bob with subtle grey streaks
physical.description: Mei Lian has a focused and intelligent gaze, with a petite but strong frame honed by years of demanding paddock work.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn-out notebook filled with handwritten track notes and setup ideas.
Insists on brewing her own blend of strong, bitter coffee at the track, believing it sharpens her focus.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically on the desk when deep in thought, sometimes driving her colleagues crazy.
